text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts were seen. Findings are consistent with an active, likely uncomplicated, bacterial UTI. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
